basics.name: Shutian Luo
basics.label: Assistant Professor at the University of Macau
basics.summary: Assistant professor working on AI infrastructure and systems for machine learning, with a focus on cloud-native microservices, RDMA-based distributed shared memory, and GPU-centric LLM and MoE serving.

work.name: University of Macau
work.summary: Assistant professor conducting research on AI systems and infrastructure, cloud-native AI platforms, and distributed systems.
highlights: Recruiting 2–3 self-motivated Ph.D. students for Fall 2027.

work.name: ByteDance
work.summary: Senior research scientist working on systems and infrastructure for large-scale AI workloads.

work.name: University of Virginia
work.position: Postdoctoral Researcher, Department of Computer Science
work.summary: Postdoctoral researcher working on AI infrastructure and systems for large-scale LLM and MoE inference on NVIDIA Superchips and heterogeneous CPU–GPU platforms.
highlights: Designed zero-copy KV-cache offloading on NVIDIA Superchips that treat CPU and GPU memory as a unified heterogeneous hierarchy, with asymmetric CUDA kernels for long-context LLM inference.

Developed C2CMoE, an on-demand expert streaming system over NVLink-C2C to eliminate MoE token all-to-all communication by aligning expert placement, streaming, and kernels with the interconnect topology.
Ongoing work on serverless LLM serving on MIG-partitioned GPUs, enabling token-level scheduling and fine-grained multi-tenant sharing.

work.name: Yale University
work.position: Postdoctoral Researcher, Department of Computer Science
work.summary: Postdoctoral researcher in the Efficient Computing Lab, working on RDMA-based distributed shared memory systems for fine-grained, latency-sensitive workloads.
highlights: Designed an RDMA-based distributed shared memory (DSM) runtime as a global-memory abstraction for fine-grained, latency-sensitive ML pipelines on RDMA-connected clusters.
Explored software-defined cache coherence and data prefetching to balance programming transparency and performance, and systematically compared DSM against RPC-based frameworks.
Extended DSM designs toward cross-GPU-node scenarios using GPU-direct RDMA and pinned memory regions as a foundation for cross-node AI memory systems.

work.name: University of Macau
work.position: Research Assistant, Cloud and Distributed Systems Lab
work.summary: Research assistant working on workload prediction and resource management for cloud-native microservices.
highlights: Investigated workload variability in large-scale microservices using deep learning for predictive autoscaling.
Proposed resource management frameworks to satisfy SLA requirements and improve resource efficiency in shared clusters.

work.name: Alibaba Cloud
work.summary: Research intern working on large-scale microservice analysis and resource management for production cloud workloads.
highlights: Analyzed large-scale microservice traces and designed resource management systems for online shopping applications to handle extreme load during the Double 11 festival.
Released Alibaba microservices trace datasets (100GB v2021 and 2TB v2022) that are widely used by industry and academic groups.
Co-designed Erms, an efficient resource management system for shared microservices with SLA guarantees.

volunteer.summary: Service to the systems and distributed computing community as a program committee member and journal reviewer.
highlights: TPC member for COINS 2025, SmartData 2024, HDIS 2023, and IEEE ScalCom 2022.
Reviewer for venues such as IEEE TPDS, ACM TOCS, and other systems and cloud computing journals.

publications.name: Characterizing Microservice Dependency and Performance: Alibaba Trace Analysis
publications.summary: Large-scale empirical study of microservice dependency graphs and performance in Alibaba production clusters, revealing over-provisioning, hotspot services, and dynamic dependencies. Awarded SoCC 2021 Best Paper.

publications.name: The Power of Prediction: Microservice Auto Scaling via Workload Learning
publications.summary: Proposes a prediction-based autoscaling approach for microservices using workload learning to improve resource efficiency and QoS.

publications.name: Derm: SLA-Aware Resource Management for Highly Dynamic Microservices

interests.name: AI Infrastructure and Systems for ML

projects.name: Alibaba Microservices Cluster Traces (v2021 & v2022)
projects.summary: Released large-scale microservice trace datasets from Alibaba Cloud (100GB v2021 and 2TB v2022) for studying microservice dependency, performance, and resource management.
highlights: Enables research on microservice call graphs, autoscaling, and QoS-aware resource management.
Widely used by both academic and industrial research groups.

projects.name: Erms: Efficient Resource Management for Shared Microservices
projects.summary: A scalable, SLA-aware resource management system for shared microservices that learns and exploits microservice dependency graphs.
highlights: Implements QoS-aware scheduling and traffic–resource co-management.
Earned ACM artifact badges for availability, functionality, and reproducibility.

projects.name: Superchip-Based LLM Infrastructure
projects.summary: Hierarchical memory systems and kernels for efficient LLM inference on NVIDIA Superchips, including zero-copy KV-cache offloading and on-demand MoE expert streaming.
highlights: Reduces GPU memory footprint for long-context LLMs while preserving or improving latency.
Aligns CUDA kernels and data movement with Superchip interconnect and memory hierarchy.

projects.name: MIG-Based Serverless LLM Serving
projects.summary: Serverless LLM serving infrastructure on MIG-partitioned GPUs with token-level scheduling and fine-grained multi-tenant sharing.
highlights: Uses MIG partitions as basic units of scheduling, autoscaling, and isolation.
Combines stateless, token-level execution with hardware-aware placement and memory management.
